text: Imagine if there was a zombie apocalypse…
And it starts tonight, while you are playing a video game.
Just you, the screen, and round twelve.
Fifth floor. Your apartment is quiet.
Then you hear it. Noise outside. Not from the game.
Screaming. A car alarm. Something heavy falling over.
You put the controller down, step onto the balcony, and look outside.
Down in the street, people are walking strangely. Slowly. Arms out in front of them.
These are not players. These are real zombies.
And they are not walking past. They are heading for your apartment complex.
The front door gives way. They are inside.
Five floors between you and them. You need a way out.
Then something bangs on your own door.
No time. You grab your keys and slip out the back, toward the fire stairs.
Down, two steps at a time. Third floor. Second. First.
You push open the emergency exit into the cold night air, and you run.
Upstairs, the game is still running. Round thirteen.
Would you have found a way out?
